ranked.headline: Learned latent representations extend transcriptomic inference across modalities
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and two published studies apply learned embeddings to single-cell, spatial, and histology-linked transcriptomic inference.

ranked.headline: Explicit gene and spatial structure in generative models for noisy single-cell data
ranked.summary: Diffusion, graph, and autoencoder models now encode gene-level or spatial structure to address batch effects, perturbations, and spatial expression.

ranked.headline: Computational tools infer cell, variant, and methylation states from sequencing data
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and papers pair new inference methods for sequencing data with simulation, benchmarking, and independent validation.

ranked.headline: Pretrained protein and DNA sequence models are being reused across modalities
ranked.summary: Recent May 2026 preprints apply learned sequence representations to survival prediction, variant interpretation, and protein feature analysis.

ranked.headline: Pangenome graphs and long-read assemblies move variant mapping beyond linear references
ranked.summary: Long-read pangenome assemblies now enable graph-based detection of repeats, mitochondrial insertions, and mobile elements across human haplotypes.

ranked.headline: Language model embeddings predict microbial regulatory and functional traits
ranked.summary: Pretrained genome and protein language models are being benchmarked and adapted for microbial annotation and regulatory prediction tasks.

ranked.headline: Long-read and RNA-chromatin methods expose artifacts alongside new RNA sequencing tools
ranked.summary: Recent papers scrutinize artifacts in widely used RNA workflows while adding long-read and multiplexed sequencing capabilities.

ranked.headline: Automated parameterization and refinement software for macromolecular simulation
ranked.summary: Recent releases package crystallographic refinement, coarse-grained model setup, and cyclic peptide parameterization as installable software.

ranked.headline: Learned representations coupled to genome-scale metabolic models infer function
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a journal article pair genome-scale metabolic models with learned protein and molecular representations to reconstruct networks.

ranked.headline: ML models infer biological dynamics and subtypes from limited or noisy measurements
ranked.summary: Sparse time-course, spatial, and population-scale omics data motivate inference methods that explicitly model missingness, smoothing, and population priors.

ranked.headline: Simulations and torsional analyses map conformational plasticity in nucleic acids
ranked.summary: Recent studies benchmark DNA force fields and simulate RNA frameshifting elements, linking conformational ensembles to RNA and DNA structure and recognition.

ranked.headline: Benchmarking and refining short- and long-read workflows for pathogen strain detection
ranked.summary: Standardized, benchmarked workflows are needed to turn raw short- and long-read data into validated strain and pathogen calls.

ranked.headline: Long-read and Hi-C assemblies yield chromosome-level genomes across eukaryotes
ranked.summary: Five preprints add chromosome-level or highly contiguous references for birds, red algae, reptiles, bees and plants, enabling comparative genome studies.

ranked.headline: Simulated and symbolic dynamical models drive parameter recovery in biological systems
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study test how ODE-simulated data, physics-informed networks and maximum entropy reduction recover biological dynamics.

ranked.headline: Learned and imaging-based models map gene regulation, E3 interfaces and drug targets
ranked.summary: Interpretable models and multimodal profiling now connect noncoding variants, E3 interfaces, and drug mechanisms to measurable readouts.

ranked.headline: MMseqs2 clustering selects minimal representative UniProt reference proteomes across life
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published tool formalize curated reference design and transparent pipelines for viral and organism-level sequence analysis.

ranked.headline: Protein language model embeddings resolve cysteine states and divergent genome annotation
ranked.summary: Learned embeddings now classify residue chemistry in predicted structures and annotate divergent genomes, extending assignment beyond sequence identity.

ranked.headline: Inferring single-cell dynamics from static snapshots via transport and neural ODEs
ranked.summary: Several May 2026 items couple optimal transport and Neural ODEs to static scRNA-seq and imaging data to recover temporal trajectories.

ranked.headline: Open tools standardize LC-MS, glycan, and multi-omics analysis workflows
ranked.summary: Interactive and command-line packages now automate end-to-end mass spectrometry and omics workflows with FAIR and reproducibility features.

ranked.headline: First-passage timing and steady-state output decouple in stochastic regulatory models
ranked.summary: Recent stochastic models treat first-passage timing and steady-state readout as separable, applied to phage lysis decisions and branching growth.

ranked.headline: AI models map molecular and cellular disease patterns in kidney and endometrial tissue
ranked.summary: Spatial omics and single-cell datasets are now paired with AI models to convert raw tissue measurements into disease-level readouts.

ranked.headline: Computational models predict HIV bNAb sensitivity and functional protein substitutions
ranked.summary: Recent items pair computational sequence and structure models with experimental screening to reduce the cost of profiling binders and mutational effects.

ranked.headline: Chirality-aware and aligned representations predict drug and metabolite outcomes
ranked.summary: Three preprints and one journal article apply learned molecule representations to affinity, side effects, dose response, and MS/MS identification.

ranked.headline: Heterogeneity in hosts, networks and pathogens shaping epidemic transmission inference
ranked.summary: Recent work infers transmission from within-host kinetics, genetic kernels and polyclonal sequence data, tying inference to heterogeneity at each scale.

ranked.headline: Pangenome graphs and network alignment reveal loci and conserved regulatory modules
ranked.summary: Graph-based pangenomes and cross-species network alignment now expose loci and conclusions that linear-reference and sequence-only methods can bias.

ranked.headline: Conformational ensembles validated against free-energy and NMR references
ranked.summary: Recent work links MD-derived conformational ensembles to binding free energies, NMR-based structure inference, and ligand design.

ranked.headline: Experimental restraints and simulation coupled to resolve large molecular assemblies
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and an open condensate pipeline pair experimental data and deep learning with physics-based simulation of flexible protein systems.

ranked.headline: Validation design now determines whether biomedical ML generalization claims hold
ranked.summary: Recent preprints show that leakage, invalid tests, and global metrics can inflate apparent performance in omics and drug-response prediction.

ranked.headline: Graph learners encoding biological priors predict cancer drivers and drug-disease links
ranked.summary: Prior-informed graph models are now applied to drug repurposing, driver gene discovery, and patient outcome prediction under label scarcity.

ranked.headline: Interpretable fMRI models map visual cortex selectivity and model-brain alignment
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and recovery-based evaluations are moving fMRI models from predictive accuracy toward claims about cortical selectivity and alignment.

ranked.headline: Batch and modality distortions corrected in single-cell and proteomics integration
ranked.summary: Batch effects and imbalanced modality composition distort single-cell and proteomics data, motivating annotation-free integration and correction methods.

ranked.headline: Neural models extend de novo peptide sequencing and retention prediction from MS data
ranked.summary: Recent models add open-PTM de novo sequencing and retention-time prediction to learned peptide identification from MS/MS.

ranked.headline: Physical models link condensate size and lamina access to chromatin organization
ranked.summary: Non-equilibrium and polymer simulations now generate testable predictions for condensate size, RNA turnover, and nuclear protein access.

ranked.headline: Constrained computational design and virtual screening for peptides and ligands
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications pair explicit design constraints with shape-, electrostatic- and AI-driven virtual screening tools for ligand discovery.

ranked.headline: Structure-aware models sharpen causal variant and genotype-phenotype inference in GWAS
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and publications add haplotype, network, and SV-imputation structure to association models that per-variant analyses omit.

ranked.headline: Geometric and Bayesian characterization of parameter and state spaces in biological models
ranked.summary: Recent preprints and a published study use topological, geometric, and feasibility-volume descriptors to organize model behavior across agent-based, ODE, and…

ranked.headline: Models map promoter configurations that decode TF dynamics and cis-element activity
ranked.summary: Computational promoter screens and CAGE analyses now yield testable predictions of regulatory element behavior, one CRISPR-validated.

ranked.headline: Computational models resolve immune kinetics from mechanics, transport, and inference
ranked.summary: Mechanistic and simulation-based models now link receptor proofreading, macrophage transitions, and airway antiviral kinetics to experimental data.

ranked.headline: Germline, mosaic and mitochondrial variation are mapped across human tissues
ranked.summary: Large sibling, UK Biobank and GTEx resources now resolve variant burden at germline, mosaic and mitochondrial levels.

ranked.headline: Compositional and mixture models refine microbiome differential analysis
ranked.summary: Normalization-invariant ranking and zero-aware mixture models address instability in compositional sequencing analysis.
